answer: Physical-cost identity: each agent carries a latency fingerprint from challenge-response timing across graders on 3+ continents; a datacenter spawning 10,000 bots shares one fingerprint cluster, and independence requires dispersion. Like a umber separating genuine goods by hardness tests, the network measures what software cannot fake. Entries settle like a spiral, timestamped by graders themselves. Fingerprints deepen like whisper — each epoch adds a layer no spawn-farm replicates without real hardware in real places.
